title: Percutaneous Vertebral Augmentation (Kyphoplasty and Vertebroplasty)
description: Medicare coverage criteria for balloon kyphoplasty and vertebroplasty. Requires acute or subacute osteoporotic vertebral compression fracture (VCF) confirmed by MRI with bone marrow edema <= 4 months old, severe focal pain (NRS >= 6/10), and failure of conservative analgesic management.

criteria.name: Severe Pain Score (NRS/VAS >= 6/10)
criteria.description: Severe debilitating focal vertebral pain with pain score >= 6 on 0-10 numeric rating scale (NRS).
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Hospitalized with severe pain (Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) or Visual Analog Scale (VAS) pain score ≥ 8) 4-7

criteria.name: Acute Edema on MRI Confirming Recent Compression Fracture
criteria.description: STIR or T2 MRI demonstrating hyperintense bone marrow edema confirming an acute/subacute fracture of the target vertebral body (or positive bone scan).
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Acute (< 6 weeks) or subacute (6-12 weeks) osteoporotic VCF (T1 – L5), based on symptom onset, and documented by advanced imaging (bone marrow edema on MRI or bone-scan/SPECT/CT uptake) 1-3,10,25,27

criteria.name: Active Spinal Infection or Chronic Healed Fracture Exclusion
criteria.description: Active osteomyelitis, discitis, epidural abscess, or completely healed chronic fracture without marrow edema.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude infection and chronic healed fractures
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Osteomyelitis, discitis, active systemic or surgical site infection
